method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 12 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: Masullo on the Riemann Hypothesis
picks.author: John Baez
picks.why_it_matters: Explains the trace-formula strategy behind Masullo's claimed GRH proof: zeros as poles, a spectral vs geometric side, Connes-style operators, plus where the argument is shaky.

picks.title: On the day the Riemann hypothesis fell to AI, I took my son for a walk
picks.author: Erik Hoel
picks.why_it_matters: A short, precise essay that sets an ordinary afternoon with a five-year-old against the day AI took the Riemann hypothesis, with the stakes left unstated.

picks.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
picks.author: happosai
picks.why_it_matters: Traces the energy supply behind AI compute, site by site, with a clear methodology (marginal grid generators, PUE, utilization) that turns gigawatts into emissions.

picks.title: After 20 years I finally learned what 'double buffering' is
picks.why_it_matters: Double buffering and screen tearing are both race conditions on a shared buffer, a connection that clicks once you see it through CUDA.

picks.title: How Magic Lantern Ghosts Helped Measure the Stars
picks.author: Danny Robb
picks.why_it_matters: Zöllner's photometer used magic-lantern ghost tricks to make artificial stars, and it taught astronomers to calibrate their own judgment rather than remove it.
